# Subway Seat for Adobe Swatch Exchange

An .ase swatch library per flavor, one named group of all 26 colors. Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and the Affinity apps all import it.

[Adobe Swatch Exchange](https://www.adobe.com/creativecloud.html) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/ase/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.ase`](Subway%20Seat.ase) | `the Swatches panel (Open Swatch Library)` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel.ase`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel.ase) | `the Swatches panel (Open Swatch Library)` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel.ase`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel.ase) | `the Swatches panel (Open Swatch Library)` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign or Affinity: the Swatches panel menu:

```text
Swatches ▸ Open Swatch Library ▸ Other Library… ▸ Subway Seat.ase
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign or Affinity: the Swatches panel menu:

```text
Swatches ▸ Open Swatch Library ▸ Other Library… ▸ Subway Seat Tunnel.ase
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign or Affinity: the Swatches panel menu:

```text
Swatches ▸ Open Swatch Library ▸ Other Library… ▸ Subway Seat Enamel.ase
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `the Swatches panel (Open Swatch Library)`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
